concerns.text: Task T008 (Normalize scores & compute Composite Collapse Metric) claims it needs baseline metrics computed per clip in T009, but T009 is scheduled after T008. This creates a producer‑before‑consumer ordering violation.

Task T009 (Derive deterministic collapse intensities) depends on the normalized data produced by T008, yet T008 itself references baselines from T009. The circular dependency indicates the tasks are misordered; T009 should precede T008 or the description should be clarified.
